widgets.title: Real errors, last hour
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) AS 'errors' FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'ai-listings' AND container_name = 'ai-listings' AND message RLIKE '(?i).*(error|exception|fail|fatal).*' AND message NOT LIKE '%"event":"proxy_check"%' AND message NOT LIKE '%"event":"proxy_redirect_to_login"%' SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Real errors over time
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) AS 'errors' FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'ai-listings' AND container_name = 'ai-listings' AND message RLIKE '(?i).*(error|exception|fail|fatal).*' AND message NOT LIKE '%"event":"proxy_check"%' AND message NOT LIKE '%"event":"proxy_redirect_to_login"%' SINCE 24 hours ago TIMESERIES 30 minutes

widgets.title: Log volume by container (ai-listings namespace)
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'ai-listings' FACET container_name SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: Error shapes
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'ai-listings' AND container_name = 'ai-listings' AND message RLIKE '(?i).*(error|exception|fail|fatal).*' AND message NOT LIKE '%"event":"proxy_check"%' AND message NOT LIKE '%"event":"proxy_redirect_to_login"%' FACET substring(message, 0, 45) SINCE 24 hours ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: supabase-auth error-level lines
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) AS 'auth errors' FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'sup-ai-listings' AND container_name = 'supabase-auth' AND message RLIKE '(?i).*(error|fatal).*' SINCE 24 hours ago TIMESERIES 30 minutes

widgets.title: Throughput (requests per minute)
widgets.nrql: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-listings' SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: p95 duration (seconds)
widgets.nrql: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-listings' SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: Error rate (percent)
widgets.nrql: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-listings' SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: Slowest transactions
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(duration), percentile(duration, 95), count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'ai-listings' FACET name SINCE 6 hours ago LIMIT 10

widgets.title: Pod restarts
widgets.nrql: SELECT max(restartCount) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName IN ('ai-listings', 'sup-ai-listings') FACET podName SINCE 24 hours ago TIMESERIES 30 minutes

widgets.title: Replicas available and missing
widgets.nrql: SELECT latest(podsAvailable), latest(podsMissing) FROM K8sDeploymentSample WHERE namespaceName IN ('ai-listings', 'sup-ai-listings') FACET deploymentName SINCE 30 minutes ago LIMIT 20

widgets.title: CPU cores per pod
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(cpuUsedCores) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName IN ('ai-listings', 'sup-ai-listings') FACET podName SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: Memory working set per pod
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(memoryWorkingSetBytes) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName IN ('ai-listings', 'sup-ai-listings') FACET podName SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: Queue depth
widgets.nrql: SELECT latest(inngest_queue_depth) FROM Metric SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 5 minutes

widgets.title: Function runs by function and status
widgets.nrql: SELECT sum(inngest_function_run_ended_total) FROM Metric FACET fn, status SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: Function failures (status not completed)
widgets.nrql: SELECT sum(inngest_function_run_ended_total) FROM Metric WHERE status != 'completed' FACET fn, status SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: Inngest CPU cores
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(cpuUsedCores) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName = 'ai-listings' AND containerName = 'inngest' FACET podName SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: Inngest memory working set
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(memoryWorkingSetBytes) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName = 'ai-listings' AND containerName = 'inngest' FACET podName SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: Log volume per Supabase container
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'sup-ai-listings' AND container_name IN ('supabase-kong', 'supabase-rest', 'supabase-auth', 'supabase-db', 'supabase-realtime', 'supabase-storage') FACET container_name SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: supabase-auth error-level lines
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) AS 'auth errors' FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'sup-ai-listings' AND container_name = 'supabase-auth' AND message RLIKE '(?i).*(error|fatal).*' SINCE 24 hours ago TIMESERIES 30 minutes

widgets.title: sup-ai-listings pods ready
widgets.nrql: SELECT latest(isReady) FROM K8sPodSample WHERE namespaceName = 'sup-ai-listings' FACET podName SINCE 30 minutes ago LIMIT 30

widgets.title: sup-ai-listings restarts
widgets.nrql: SELECT max(restartCount) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName = 'sup-ai-listings' FACET podName, containerName SINCE 1 hour ago LIMIT 30

widgets.title: github-runner restarts
widgets.nrql: SELECT max(restartCount) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName = 'github-runner' SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: github-runner CPU cores
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(cpuUsedCores) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName = 'github-runner' FACET podName SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: github-runner memory working set
widgets.nrql: SELECT average(memoryWorkingSetBytes) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE namespaceName = 'github-runner' FACET podName SINCE 6 hours ago TIMESERIES 10 minutes

widgets.title: github-runner container logs
widgets.nrql: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE namespace_name = 'github-runner' SINCE 24 hours ago TIMESERIES 30 minutes
